examples.label: Sign-in card with email and password
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h3" site="Global" size="large" font_weight="font-semibold">Welcome back <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" color="natural">Sign in to pick up where you left off.
<.component component_name="chelekom-email-field" site="Global" id="signin-email" name="email" value="" label="Email" floating="outer" placeholder="you@example.com" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-password-field" site="Global" id="signin-password" name="password" value="" label="Password" floating="outer" placeholder="Your password" show_password />
<.component component_name="chelekom-checkbox-field" site="Global" id="signin-remember" name="remember" value="true" label="Keep me signed in" size="small" /> Forgot password?
<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="default" color="primary" full_width>Sign in

examples.label: Change password panel with confirmation
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold">Change your password <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" color="natural">Everyone signed in on another device will be signed out.
<.component component_name="chelekom-password-field" site="Global" id="change-current-password" name="current_password" value="" label="Current password" floating="outer" placeholder="Enter your current password" show_password /> <.component component_name="chelekom-password-field" site="Global" id="change-new-password" name="new_password" value="" label="New password" floating="outer" description="At least twelve characters, and not one you have used here before." placeholder="Enter a new password" show_password /> <.component component_name="chelekom-password-field" site="Global" id="change-confirm-password" name="confirm_password" value="" label="Confirm new password" floating="outer" placeholder="Type it once more" />
<.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="outline" color="natural">Cancel <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="default" color="primary">Update password

examples.label: Account creation step with password rules listed
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold">Choose a password <.component component_name="chelekom-password-field" site="Global" id="signup-password" name="password" value="" label="Password" floating="outer" placeholder="Create a password" show_password rounded="medium" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-ul" site="Global" class="space-y-1 text-sm text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400"> <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global">Twelve characters or more <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global">A number or a symbol somewhere in it <.component component_name="chelekom-li" site="Global">Nothing you already use on another site <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" variant="default" color="primary" full_width>Create account
